item.title: Israelis denounce Trump’s deal with Iran
item.description: Israeli officials disparaged the peace deal and said Israel’s fight against Hezbollah in Lebanon would go on.

item.title: After news of Iran peace deal, Lebanese return home to assess wreckage
item.description: Some war-weary residents displaced from the south found relative quiet, with guarded optimism that Trump will pressure Israel to adhere to a truce.

item.title: In Mideast and worldwide, cautious relief over deal to end damaging war
item.description: Some world leaders hailed the deal, but many in the Middle East were cautious, saying important details remain to be settled and warning the accord could easily fall apart.

item.title: Trump swings back toward diplomacy in escalating war with Iran
item.description: After threatening a “massive attack,” the president said his envoys were talking with Tehran but left open the possibility of a sharp military escalation.

item.title: House votes to limit Trump on Iran; Senate fails to advance similar measure
item.description: The votes marked the first test of Republican support for the conflict since President Donald Trump resumed military strikes against Tehran this month.

item.title: Oil prices leap to $100 a barrel after attacks in Red Sea
item.description: The price of Brent crude, now up about 40 percent this month, surged Thursday after Iran’s Houthi allies in Yemen claimed strikes on Saudi tankers.
